convertir-a-pdf.title: Convert to PDF
convertir-a-pdf.description: Convert Word, TXT, and images to PDF inside your browser. No uploads, no sign-up.
convertir-a-pdf.cta: Need to generate PDFs automatically from your system (invoices, reports, contracts)? We'll build it for you.
convertir-a-pdf.seoTitle: Convert to PDF Free in Your Browser | SonhoLab
convertir-a-pdf.seoDescription: Convert Word, TXT, or images to PDF free, no sign-up. Everything runs in your browser, so your file is never uploaded to a server and gets no watermark.
convertir-a-pdf.intro: This tool turns Word documents, text files, and images into a PDF you can send right away. Everything happens inside your browser, so the file is never uploaded to a server. It helps when someone asks you for a PDF and you don't have any program installed to make one.
convertir-a-pdf.step1Text: Drag the document or image into the box, or click to browse your device. It takes Word (.docx), text (.txt), and JPG, PNG, and WEBP images.
convertir-a-pdf.step2Text: The conversion runs instantly in your browser, with no queue. Look over the PDF, and if you picked the wrong file, swap it and try again.
convertir-a-pdf.step3Text: Click download and the PDF is saved to your device, with no watermark. If you need to convert another file, just repeat the process as often as you like.
convertir-a-pdf.useCase1: School asks for the homework as a PDF and your kid wrote it in Word: convert it and send it without installing anything.
convertir-a-pdf.useCase2: You sell over WhatsApp and a customer wants the price list as a PDF: convert the Word file and send it in the same chat.
convertir-a-pdf.useCase3: You scanned an invoice or a contract with your phone and it came out as a JPG: turn it into a PDF before uploading it.
convertir-a-pdf.faq1q: Are my files uploaded to a server?
convertir-a-pdf.faq1a: No. The conversion happens entirely inside your browser, using the file already on your device. It never passes through our servers or anyone else's, so you can convert contracts, invoices, or documents with personal data without exposing them.
convertir-a-pdf.faq2q: Is it free? Is there a file limit?
convertir-a-pdf.faq2a: It's free with no limit: convert as many files as you need, one after another, with no account, no watermark, and no queue. Since the work is done by your own device and not by a server of ours, we have no per-file cost to charge you.
convertir-a-pdf.faq3q: Does the Word document keep its formatting?
convertir-a-pdf.faq3a: Only partly. We take the text from the .docx and put it into the PDF, so complex tables, columns, and some styles won't come out the same. It works well for running text; if the layout matters a lot, check the result before you send it.
convertir-a-pdf.faq4q: Which files can I convert to PDF?
convertir-a-pdf.faq4a: Word (.docx), plain text (.txt), and JPG, PNG, and WEBP images. Images are normalized to PNG before they're embedded, so they look the same in any reader. Other formats, like Excel or PowerPoint, aren't supported yet.
convertir-a-pdf.faq5q: Do I need to install anything or create an account?
convertir-a-pdf.faq5a: Neither one. Open the page, pick your file, and download the PDF. We don't ask for an email or create accounts, and there's nothing to install: it works in the browser you already have, on a computer or a phone.
